info.name: E-Commerce API v1
info.description:
Node / Express 5 / Mongoose e-commerce API.

The base URL comes from the {{baseUrl}} variable (default http://localhost:8000). Import the local environment next to this file, or edit the collection variable.

Every request is self-contained: creates store their id in a collection variable ({{categoryId}}, {{subCategoryId}}, {{brandId}}, {{productId}}), deletes clear it again, and the requests that need a parent category create one on the fly if there is none. So you can hit Send on anything, in any order, or run the whole collection with newman.

All list endpoints share the same query API: page, limit (capped at 100), sort, fields, keyword, plus any field filter with gte / gt / lte / lt.

item.name: Categories
item.description: CRUD for /api/v1/categories. name: 3-32 chars, unique. The slug is generated from the name.

request.description: Paginated list. Response shape: { results, pagination: { currentPage, limit, numberOfPages, totalDocuments, nextPage?, prevPage? }, data }
Required: name (3-32, unique). Optional: image. Stores the new id in {{categoryId}}.
Every field is optional but still validated when sent. The slug is regenerated with the name.
Returns 204 with an empty body, and clears {{categoryId}}.

item.name: SubCategories
item.description: CRUD for /api/v1/subcategories plus the nested form under a category. name: 2-32 chars, unique. category must be an existing category id.

request.description: createFilterObj turns :categoryId into a { category } filter.
Required: name (2-32, unique), category (must exist). Stores the new id in {{subCategoryId}}.
setCategoryIdToBody copies :categoryId into the body, so category can be omitted here.
Required: name (3-32, unique). Stores the new id in {{brandId}}.

item.name: Products
item.description: CRUD for /api/v1/products. Supports keyword search over title + description, field filters (price[gte] and friends), sort, field limiting and pagination.

request.description: The minimum a product needs: title (3-100), description (20-2000), quantity, price (max 20000), imageCover, category (must exist). Everything else is optional - see the next request for the full body.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra",
  "description": "Flagship Android phone with a 6.8 inch display, 200MP camera and S-Pen support. Ships with a two year regional warranty.",
  "quantity": 25,
  "price": 1199.99,
  "imageCover": "https://example.com/images/s24-ultra-cover.jpg",
  "category": "{{categoryId}}"
}

request.description: Full body. Optional on top of the minimum: sold, priceAfterDiscount (must be lower than price), colors[], images[], subcategories[] (every id must belong to the given category), brand (must exist), ratingsAverage (1-5), ratingsQuantity. The pre-request script creates a fresh category > subcategory > brand chain first, so the relations always line up.

  "title": "Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra 1TB",
  "description": "Flagship Android phone with a 6.8 inch display, 200MP camera and S-Pen support. Ships with a two year regional warranty.",

}
